events.description: A man in a suit is being strangled by an unseen assailant (implied by the white cloth wrapped around his neck and his hands pulling at it while his head is forced back); he appears helpless and in distress throughout the sequence.

The man in the suit actively struggles against the strangulation, using both hands to pull at the cloth around his neck and attempting to free himself; this constitutes mutual physical resistance against an attacker, even if the attacker is off-screen or obscured.

A man in a suit is being forcibly restrained and choked by an unseen assailant (only hands visible), while another man observes; the victim's expression and posture indicate he is helpless and under attack.
An orange sports car is engulfed in flames, with fire erupting from its engine bay and front compartment, indicating a post-collision fire or explosion; a silver car is parked nearby.
A large, rapid-fire explosion erupts from an orange sports car in a courtyard, engulfing the area in fire and debris; a person is visibly thrown by the blast in frames f12–f14.

An orange sports car is shown with its front end severely damaged and on fire (frame f6), indicating a prior high-impact collision before the explosion; the fire appears to originate from the engine bay.
A large, sudden fireball explosion erupts from a burning orange sports car in an open plaza, rapidly expanding and engulfing the area; visible across frames f4–f11.

An orange sports car is shown with its hood open and flames erupting from the engine bay, indicating a post-collision fire or mechanical failure leading to ignition; visible in frame f3 and initiating the explosion in f4.
